intro.h2: Detailed quotes and daily cleanup, not surprises
paragraphs: If you are pricing bathroom remodeling in Westlake Village, you will probably collect more than one bid. One recent Google reviewer did exactly that, chose All Exclusive Construction after three estimates, and wrote that its price was not the cheapest but felt the most honest and detailed, with no surprises once work began.

The company has worked across Southern California since 2018 and holds California Contractor License #1120170. Its team manages each job from design and permits through the build and the final walkthrough, from an office on Townsgate Road. Showers and full bathrooms lead the work, and kitchens, ADUs and additions are on the list too.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Westlake Village and beyond

items.name: Full bathroom remodels
items.blurb: From dated primary baths to guest bathrooms, the crew guts the space, reworks the layout, sets custom tile and installs new vanities and fixtures. A featured Santa Clarita job added a walk-in shower with frameless glass, a floating vanity and heated tile floors.

image.alt: Remodeled Santa Clarita bathroom with a navy double vanity, two oval mirrors, marble-look tile walls and a glass shower

items.name: Shower remodels and tub-to-shower conversions
items.blurb: Swap an old tub for a spacious walk-in shower, or rebuild a shower with custom tile or stone and frameless glass. One Google reviewer hired the crew to install a shower at a Westlake Village rental and called the response fast and the prices reasonable.

image.alt: Reseda bathroom remodel with a sliding glass shower door, gray wall tile, a built-in niche and wood-look floor tile

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Cabinets, countertops, backsplash, flooring and lighting, planned around how you cook. Recent Calabasas work includes a waterfall-edge island and seamless stone counters. The company's Westlake Village price guide runs from about $45k for a basic remodel to $150k and up for a luxury kitchen.

image.alt: Calabasas kitchen remodel with white cabinets, a marble-look stone island, stainless refrigerator and built-in wall ovens

items.name: ADUs and home additions
items.blurb: When you need more room rather than a new look, the same licensed team builds ADUs and home additions and handles framing, structure, permits and finishes. A current example is a two-story ADU going up in Santa Clarita.

about.text: All Exclusive Construction Inc is a locally owned company that has served Southern California since 2018. Owner Jacob Beckert works closely with each client to understand their goals, and reviewers often mention him by name. One thanked “Jake” for a kitchen that stayed on budget and on schedule. Another described how Jacob brought in a professional cabinet maker to rebuild a poorly made 120-inch, two-sink vanity installed by another builder. The company belongs to the Santa Clarita Valley, Greater Conejo Valley and Simi Valley chambers of commerce and posts job site walkthroughs on its YouTube channel.

faq.h2: Bathroom questions from Conejo Valley homeowners

items.q: Is All Exclusive Construction licensed and insured?
items.a: Yes. The company holds California Contractor License #1120170 and describes itself as licensed, bonded and insured. It carries full insurance on every project, so you are covered from the first day of demolition through final sign-off. The license number appears in the footer of every page on its website.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost?
items.a: The company's bathroom page lists three ranges, depending on size and scope: about $15k to $30k+ for a small bath or powder room, $30k to $45k+ for a medium full bathroom, and $45k to $75k+ for a luxury makeover with heated floors. Your written estimate after the free consultation sets the actual number.

items.q: Can you convert my tub into a walk-in shower?
items.a: Yes. Tub-to-shower conversions are one of the bathroom services the company lists, along with custom tile or stone showers, frameless glass enclosures, heated tile floors and floating vanities. Its project list also includes aging-in-place features and barrier-free, wheelchair accessible bathrooms for homeowners planning ahead.

items.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
items.a: No. Estimates are free with no obligation, and each estimate request includes a free in-home consultation. The office replies to every inquiry within 24 hours. Phone hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM, and you can send the estimate form any time.

items.q: Do you handle HOA approval and permits in Westlake Village?
items.a: Yes. The team handles HOA architectural review submissions for North Ranch and other gated Westlake Village communities, and it manages permits through the City of Westlake Village Building Department. Permitting is built into every project's plan before demolition starts, so you are not chasing paperwork yourself.
